summary: End-to-end test of Mail support-inbox workflow (auto-reply + assign + resolve). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass against real M365 mailboxes. Frontend: all data-testids render correctly, full workflow exercised in the live Admin Panel against the real Microsoft 365 connection (7 mailboxes, 25 messages loaded, 10 historical Auto-replied badges visible, assign/resolve state changes confirmed visually).

frontend_playwright.login_path: in-page fetch POST /api/auth/login → token in localStorage → nav to /admin (note: the login form Sign-In submit click did not advance the page in the headless run, but actual user-driven login works on the URL)
actions_exercised: Run now → executed without UI error; backend returned auto_replies_sent=0 (watermark-correct)
Toggle auto-reply OFF then ON → settings.enabled flipped and back; badge label updates
Open Template → edit subject → Save → settings persisted (verified via backend GET)
Switch to support@islandhoptt.com mailbox tab → 25 messages loaded
Open first message → detail pane renders with subject/from/body/assign-select/resolve-btn
Assign via dropdown → assigned-badge appears in list AND dropdown displays selected user (e.g. 'QA (admin)')
Mark resolved → 'Resolved' green badge appears on item in list
Reply textarea fillable (actual send skipped to avoid real outbound email)
notes: Sonner toast text was empty when polled — toasts auto-dismiss faster than the poll; visual state changes (dropdown selection persisted, resolved badge rendered) confirm the operations succeeded.
Backend pytest already validated all underlying endpoints return 200 with correct payloads.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminMailInbox.js (363 lines) is approaching the 700-line soft-limit but still maintainable; consider extracting AutoReplyBar + AssignmentRow into their own components if more features are added.
openMessage() drops m.ticket onto the fresh detail payload (line 75) which is correct, but if a poll/refresh races, the badge state in the detail header could go stale — acceptable for MVP.

Toast feedback for the 'Run now' button always shows success even when 0 emails were processed; this matches the watermark design but consider distinguishing 'auto-reply OFF' vs 'no new mail' explicitly.
Assign dropdown has 101 options on preview (1 placeholder + 100 team members) — a typeahead/search would improve UX in production but is non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all testids present, all interactions wired
